title: Skill package manifest
description: Selection metadata for one skill package (ADR-0028). Deliberately NOT an Agent Card: a package instructs, a card advertises, and the two are separate records mapped by agent_card_skill_id. The schema refuses Agent Card keys and every tool-authority key, because a manifest that could name a tool or a permission would be granting authority that belongs to the runtime allowlist and the state-keyed policy table.

manifest_version.description: Format version of this manifest. Bumped only on a breaking change to the package format.

name.description: Package name in kebab-case. Must equal the containing directory name.

version.description: Semantic version of the instruction body. A change to procedure or boundaries is a version change.

title.description: Human-readable name for logs and traces.

owner_agent.description: The section 3 agent role this package instructs. One of the seven; care_coordinator routes and owns no package.

summary.description: One line (no newline) stating what the skill produces. This is what a selector shows and scores against.

when_to_use.description: Concrete triggers a selector can match without reading the body.

path.description: Path relative to the package directory.

purpose.description: One line saying what the file is for.

references.description: Read-only material the body cites. Loaded only when the selected skill cites it.

authority.description: This package carries instructions and confers no authority of any kind.

grants_tool_permissions.description: Always false. A constant, not a convention: tool authority lives in the runtime allowlist and in the database policy table keyed by workflow state.

agent_card_skill_id.description: Identifier of the Agent Card skill entry this package is mapped to. The card advertises; the package instructs. Never equal to the package name.
